ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 60% low-intensity (black) to 40% high-intensity (white/mottled) pixel distribution across visible surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe exhibits extensive high-intensity white mottling across 70% of its surface; left lobe features a predominant low-intensity black field with high-intensity white clusters concentrated along the trailing edge and medial zone.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression; approximate interior angle of 140 degrees with depth partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary; peaks and valleys are most prominent on the distal half of the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to both lobes, transitioning to rounded lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white on black) localized in the lower-central region of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe, extending from the trailing edge inward.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular dark-textured mass (potential kelp or growth) attached to the left distal tip; deep secondary indentation/notch on the left lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark organic protrusion at the far left lateral extremity.
